audit.why: FAVOURED at 54.11% over 2349 games is right. Brand is a 625-to-1050 range immobile caster with no dash and one defensive button (a conditional stun); Katarina's difficulty is entirely 'do not be ablaze in Q range'.
audit.corrected: Early, mid and teamfights all Katarina; his only real edge is a choke fight where Pyroclasm bounces.

audit.why: Both layers and the packet already read Katarina on all seven rows, and the kit supports it: Level 3 Shunpo punishes every Pillar of Flame on its 10s cooldown, Level 6 Death Lotus beats a rotation that needs Blaze stacks to complete, and 2+ items he is still immobile.
audit.corrected: No chart change. Ratings left as-is; only phases whys and prose were touched, none of which change a verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: The one interaction that decides the matchup — Sear stunning only through Blaze, and that stun cancelling the Death Lotus channel — was implied but never stated as a channel interrupt. breakdown.cooldowns carried no cooldown number, and dosFull[1].d / dontsFull[2].d were tradeGood / tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Katarina's R is flagged 'channel — interruptible, any CC cancels it'. Brand's only hard CC is Sear, and Riot's text gates it on the target being ablaze. So the whole fight order is: clear or avoid Blaze, then channel. Pyroclasm only slows an ablaze target, so it does NOT break the channel — that distinction matters and is now written.
audit.corrected: Stated in dontsFull[2].d and report[5].t; real numbers (Sear 8s->6s at 1050 range, Pillar of Flame 10s->8s, Pyroclasm 100/90/80) now live in breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.why: Pillar of Flame at 10s rank 1 and 60 mana is the punishable cooldown — it is his wave clear and his poke, and Shunpo is 12s, so a missed W is a real window.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with per-rank numbers for Q, W and R.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.wave used the placeholder 'a CC mage's tower' with nothing about Brand in it.
audit.why: The specific wave danger is a freeze near his tower where one Conflagration puts Blaze on you and arms the next Sear.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around his single-W clear and the Blaze-then-stun sequence.

audit.whatIsWrong: The brief's missingInteractions claims 'Brand can deny your mobility (Shunpo) with Pillar of Flame'. That is built on a 'terrain' derived flag on W which contradicts Riot's own description.
audit.why: Riot's text for Pillar of Flame is a delayed area that deals damage to units inside it — no terrain is created and nothing about it stops a dash or a blink. Writing the dash-denial would have taught a false rule.
audit.corrected: Not written anywhere. Only the damage-zone behaviour and its cooldown are used.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. It governs your forward steps. - E Shunpo (second use) spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Sear (Q): 8s at rank 1, 6s at rank 5, 1050 range — it only stuns you while Blaze is on you, so clean the stack off before you step up. - Pillar of Flame (W): 10s down to 8s, his whole wave clear. - Pyroclasm (R): 100/90/80, and it needs bounce targets to hurt.
